items.html: Now, these Mochin, which are the aforementioned Hassadim, are drawn to AVI together with the vessels of the NHY of AA, similar to the Mochin of ZA that are drawn clothed within the NHY of AVI. Now, these NHY of AA, too, descended below together with the posteriors of AVI, and inasmuch as they come from AA, it turns out that this matter, too, is called a deficiency for the upper point, called Keter. And we have already explained that this, too, is called a discernment of deficiency in Keter, and this was caused because it does not take the light of the Ozen except at its end and not at its beginning, as mentioned above. But since these NHY have already expanded in the secret of the vessels of Mochin within AVI, this deficiency is called by the name of AVI, and not by the name of Keter.
